answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Each submission hangs on the vine of a task receipt, and the ember is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. By the reef of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
